title: Premium Billing Accounts — Payment Methods, Binder and Payment Application Schedule
content:
The payments desk applies, per Premium Billing Accounts arrangement, the methods, thresholds and limits in this schedule.

### Terms
- **Accepted payment methods** — list of payment methods accepted on the arrangement.
- **AutoPay required** — whether the arrangement must keep an automatic draft (EFT or card) on file.
- **Payment application order** — how a payment is applied: oldest unpaid month first.
- **Paid-through advance basis** — the paid-through date advances only by whole coverage months fully paid (full months only).
- **Payment threshold** — integer percent of the net premium due that counts as full payment for grace and lapse purposes (a shortfall within the threshold carries forward as a balance).
- **Group underpayment tolerance** — USD; a group remittance short by no more than this amount counts as full payment and the shortfall carries forward; 0.00 for individual arrangements.
- **Months payable in advance** — count of future coverage months that may be paid ahead; payments beyond it are refunded.
- **Payment-method change lead time** — calendar days before the next draft date by which a payment-method change must be confirmed to apply to that draft.
- **Binder amount basis** — amount of the binder: first billing period, meaning the premium for the first billing period of the arrangement.
- **Binder payment methods** — list of payment methods accepted for the binder.

### Methods
| Arrangement | Accepted payment methods | AutoPay required | Binder payment methods |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | check, card | no | card, check |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | EFT, card | yes | EFT, card |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | check, card, EFT | no | card, check, EFT |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | check, card, EFT | no | card, check, EFT |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | EFT, card, check, exchange APTC | no | card, EFT, check |
| Cascade Group List Bill | employer remittance | no | employer remittance |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | employer remittance | no | employer remittance |

### Application and limits
| Arrangement | Payment threshold (percent) | Group underpayment tolerance (USD) | Months payable in advance | Payment-method change lead time (days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly | 100 | 0.00 | 3 | 0 |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 100 | 0.00 | 3 | 5 |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 100 | 0.00 | 6 | 5 |
| Cascade Individual Annual Prepay | 100 | 0.00 | 12 | 5 |
| Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly | 98 | 0.00 | 3 | 5 |
| Cascade Group List Bill | 100 | 25.00 | 2 | 0 |
| Cascade Group Self-Administered Bill | 100 | 50.00 | 2 | 0 |

On every arrangement the application order is oldest unpaid month first, the paid-through date advances by full months only, and the binder is the premium for the first billing period.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a Cascade Exchange SADP Monthly account with a net monthly premium of 40.00, a month counts as fully paid once 98 percent of it, 39.20, has been applied, the remaining 0.80 carrying forward as balance. On a Cascade Group List Bill account a remittance short by 25.00 or less counts as full payment, the shortfall carrying forward; one short by 25.01 does not.
